title: SWE-fficiency: Can Language Models Optimize Real-World Repositories on Real Workloads?
authors_zh: Jeffrey Jian Ma, Milad Hashemi, Amir Yazdanbakhsh, Kevin Swersky, Ofir Press, Enhui Li, Vijay Janapa Reddi, Parthasarathy Ranganathan
paper_type_zh: 可程序验证的仓库级性能优化基准
best_for_zh: 需要以正确性测试和可复现运行时共同评测代码智能体的研究者。
one_line: SWE-fficiency tests performance engineering on 498 real repository workloads, requiring an agent to preserve correctness while matching expert speedups.
SWE-fficiency 用 498 个真实工作负载任务衡量智能体能否在通过单测的同时达到或逼近专家性能加速。
why: It evaluates a patch through executable behavior and measured runtime rather than a text-only judgment.
inclusion_reason: Each record couples a repository modification with executable tests and a measured terminal performance outcome.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Many performance benchmarks reveal target functions or evaluate micro-kernels, omitting profiling, call-chain understanding, bottleneck localization, and regression-test selection required of real performance engineers. Simply checking whether code becomes faster can also reward tiny satisficing improvements without measuring proximity to expert optimizations.

SWE-fficiency defines pass-to-pass repository performance tasks. Agents receive a complete codebase and a slow workload without a repair location and must investigate, edit, and preserve relevant unit tests. Its 498 tasks come from nine major Python scientific-computing and HPC repositories. Expert pull-request speedups provide baselines, and Speedup Ratio measures how much of the expert-achievable gain an agent recovers.

许多性能 benchmark 告诉模型要修改的函数或只测微型 kernel，省略真实 performance engineer 必须完成的 profiling、调用链理解、瓶颈定位和相关回归测试选择。仅比较修改前后是否更快也会奖励轻微“凑合式”优化，无法判断模型是否接近专家在同一 PR 中实现的加速。

SWE-fficiency 设计 pass-to-pass 仓库性能任务：给 agent 完整代码库和一个慢 workload，不提示具体修复位置；agent 必须调查、修改并让相关单测保持通过。498 个任务来自 9 个主流 Python 科学计算/HPC 仓库，以专家 PR 的 speedup 为基线，用 Speedup Ratio 衡量模型获得了多少专家可实现的收益。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is 498 autonomous-investigation optimization tasks and an expert-anchored metric. The dataset covers NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, xarray, SymPy, Dask, and Astropy. Each record includes a base commit, slow workload, gold performance pull request, coverage-selected correctness tests, container, and repeated timing baselines. A patch receives a performance score only after passing relevant tests. SR = model speedup / expert speedup, aggregated by harmonic mean, with 1.0 matching the expert. The automated pipeline combines pull-request keywords, static analysis, coverage, and execution validation, supporting performance-agent benchmarking and continuous rewards.

核心贡献是 498 个“自主调查型”性能优化任务及 expert-anchored metric。数据覆盖 NumPy、pandas、SciPy、scikit-learn、Matplotlib、xarray、SymPy、Dask 和 Astropy；每条包含 base commit、慢 workload、gold performance PR、由 coverage 找到的相关正确性测试、容器和多次运行基线。补丁只有先通过相关单元测试才计算性能，SR = model speedup / expert speedup，全局用 harmonic mean 聚合，1.0 表示达到专家。自动 pipeline 结合 PR 关键词、静态分析、coverage 与执行验证；官方数据和工具可用于性能 agent benchmark 与连续 reward。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Filter performance changes: Mine pull requests from nine repositories and use performance keywords and static diffs to identify likely runtime reductions, excluding pure refactors and unreplayable changes.
  1. Extract workloads and tests: Reconstruct benchmark or performance scripts from pull requests and use coverage on the base version to find unit tests exercising relevant paths, forming a slow workload plus behavior that must remain unchanged.
  1. Measure expert gains stably: Repeatedly run base and gold patches in containers with pinned CPU and memory, filter noisy, failing, or non-improving tasks, and record expert speedups.
  1. Evaluate agents: Give agents full repositories and workloads with a three-hour and 100-action limit. Patches must pass correctness tests before SR is computed. Reproduction requires fixed 4-vCPU/16-GB resources, hardware, warmup, repetitions, and aggregation.

1. 筛选性能变更： 从九个仓库抓取 PR，用性能关键词和静态 diff 识别可能减少运行时间的候选，排除纯重构和不可重放修改。
  1. 提取 workload 与测试： 还原 PR 中的 benchmark/性能脚本，在 base 上用 coverage 找到执行路径相关的单元测试，形成“要加速的 workload + 必须保持的行为”。
  1. 稳定测量专家收益： 在容器中多次运行 base 与 gold patch，固定 CPU/内存并过滤噪声、失败或无稳定 speedup 的任务，记录 expert speedup。
  1. 评测 agent： 提供完整仓库和 workload，限制 3 小时、最多 100 actions；补丁先过 correctness tests，再计算 SR。复现需固定 4 vCPU/16GB、硬件型号、热身、重复次数和聚合规则。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates 11 frontier model and agent systems, all averaging below 0.15 times the expert Speedup Ratio, meaning they recover only a small fraction of expert gains. Error analysis shows agents often select different, shallower functions than gold patches or introduce regressions while optimizing. The evolving project leaderboard later reports stronger systems, for example around 0.225 times, but still far below the 1.0 expert baseline; paper results and current leaderboard values must be separated. The 498 real workloads support external validity, but harmonic-mean aggregation, timeout and failure handling affect ranks, and expert pull requests are not guaranteed global optima.

论文评测 11 个 frontier model/agent，平均 Speedup Ratio 均低于 0.15× 专家，即模型通常只获得专家加速的一小部分；错误分析显示 agent 经常选择与 gold 不同且影响较浅的函数，或在加速时引入回归。项目页后续 leaderboard 的最佳系统可高于论文初始值，例如达到约 0.225×，但仍远低于 1.0 专家基线，因此应区分论文固定结果与持续更新榜单。498 题和真实 workload 支持外部有效性，但 SR 的 harmonic mean、超时和失败赋值会影响排名，专家 PR 也不保证全局最优。

title: Novelty
新意
html: SWE-Perf already uses real performance pull requests but offers target-function or oracle settings and emphasizes speeding up a specified region, while SWE-bench uses fail-to-pass repair. SWE-fficiency evaluates the full investigative workflow: agents receive only a slow workload and must profile, localize files and tests, and perform pass-to-pass optimization. It also scores model speedup relative to the expert on each task instead of using raw runtime or a binary pass. The work proposes no optimizer; it changes information exposure, workflow, and metrics so minor gains are distinguished from expert-level improvements.

SWE-Perf 已使用真实性能 PR，但提供 target function/oracle 设置，侧重“修改指定区域是否加速”；传统 SWE-bench 则是 fail-to-pass 修复。SWE-fficiency 的变化是评测完整 investigative workflow：只给慢 workload，让 agent 自己 profiling、定位相关文件和测试，再进行 pass-to-pass 优化；并用模型相对同题专家的 SR，而非简单 runtime 或二值通过率。它未提出新优化器，而是改变信息暴露、任务流程和指标，使轻微加速与专家级修复被明确区分。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Timing reproducibility: Even with 4 vCPUs and 16 GB, caches, frequency scaling, and shared-host noise affect SR, especially for short workloads. Runs should be repeated with uncertainty reported, and speedups below a noise threshold rejected.
  1. Tests and performance target: Coverage-selected tests do not prove all behavior is preserved, and agents may overfit the benchmark workload while harming other inputs. Wider regression suites and multiple workloads are needed.
  1. Scope and metric: All 498 tasks come from nine Python scientific libraries and exclude C++, GPUs, distributed systems, memory, and energy. Expert pull requests are not unique optima, and harmonic-mean SR is sensitive to failure handling. Cross-system comparisons require fixed versions and scoring scripts.

1. 计时可重复性： 即使固定 4 vCPU/16GB，缓存、频率调节和共享主机噪声仍会改变 SR，尤其是短 workload。应重复运行、报告置信区间，并拒绝低于噪声阈值的加速。
  1. 测试与性能目标： coverage 选出的相关测试不能证明所有行为保持，agent 还可能针对 benchmark workload 特化而损害其他输入。需运行更广回归测试和多 workload 验证。
  1. 范围与指标： 498 题均为 9 个 Python 科学库，未覆盖 C++、GPU、分布式或内存/能耗；专家 PR 不是唯一最优，SR harmonic mean 对失败处理敏感。跨系统比较需固定版本和计分脚本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate autonomous performance agents: Run OpenHands or SWE-agent under fixed resources and report correctness pass, SR, expert parity, actions or time, and repository- and optimization-type-stratified results.
  1. Study localization and profiling: Compare agent flamegraphs and edited functions with gold patches and train workload-to-bottleneck retrieval. Success still requires speedup on independent workloads and regression tests.
  1. Performance RL: Gate rewards by correctness and use clipped SR as continuous reward while modeling timing noise and timeouts. Results are not comparable when hardware differs from the official environment, measurements are not repeated, or the 498 test tasks are used directly for training.

1. 自主性能 agent 评测： 在固定资源下运行 OpenHands/SWE-agent，报告 correctness pass、SR、expert parity、action/time 和按仓库/优化类型分层结果。
  1. 定位与 profiling 研究： 分析 agent flamegraph、修改函数与 gold patch 差异，训练 workload→bottleneck retriever；成功仍以独立 workload 加速和回归测试为准。
  1. 性能 RL： 将正确性作为门控，将裁剪后的 SR 作为连续 reward，并对噪声和超时建模。若硬件与官方环境不同、无法重复测量或准备把 498 test 题直接训练，结果不具可比性且会污染 benchmark。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: SWE-fficiency provides 498 real workloads across nine repositories, requiring autonomous localization and scoring optimization through expert-relative Speedup Ratio.
  1. Method takeaway: Pull-request filtering, static and coverage localization, stable expert-speedup measurement, correctness gating, and SR aggregation form the pipeline.
  1. Data takeaway: Each task contains a full repository, workload, relevant tests, expert patch, and container, concentrated in Python scientific computing.
  1. Evidence anchor: All 11 paper systems average below 0.15 times expert performance; later leaderboard leaders reach about 0.225 times but remain far behind.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits investigative performance engineering. Timing noise and workload overfitting require fixed hardware, repeated measurement, and broader tests.

1. 一句话定位： SWE-fficiency 提供 498 个九仓库真实 workload，让 agent 自主定位并以相对专家 Speedup Ratio 评测优化。
  1. 方法抓手： PR 筛选、静态/coverage 定位、稳定 expert speedup 测量、正确性门控和 SR 聚合构成 pipeline。
  1. 数据抓手： 每题含完整仓库、workload、相关测试、专家 patch 与容器；任务集中于 Python 科学计算。
  1. 证据锚点： 论文中 11 个系统平均均低于 0.15× 专家；后续最佳榜单约 0.225×，仍有巨大差距。
  1. 复用决定： 适合 investigative performance engineering；最大风险是计时噪声和 workload 过拟合，必须固定硬件、重复测量和扩展测试。
